name: Parts Direct Warehouse
old_description: Parts Direct was started in 2013 to provide the highest quality parts and service to the NW suburbs of Chicago. We search high and low for the best parts with the lowest warranty rates in the industry.
about:
Parts Direct Warehouse was founded in 2013 in Crystal Lake, Illinois, as a family-owned wholesale auto parts supplier targeting the northwest suburbs of Chicago. The business traces its roots to the late 1980s when Bob, one of the two founders, worked in the radiator industry during its shift from recoring to all-new units. His partner, Mike, began his career delivering auto parts while in college, mastering pricing, inventory management, and operations. Together they launched Parts Direct to deliver high-quality components with the lowest warranty rates in the market.

The company operates as a distributor of powertrain components, transmissions, and under-car/hood parts, sourcing from leading manufacturers to serve automotive repair shops and fleet operators. Its Crystal Lake facility supports 24/7 online ordering for under-car and under-hood categories, and a delivery fleet that the founders personally vet for reliability. While specific facility size and headcount are not disclosed, the operation emphasizes rapid turnaround and inventory accuracy.

Primary customers are independent repair shops and small automotive businesses throughout the Chicagoland area. The founders position themselves as fellow small business owners who understand the pressure of every penny and minute, tailoring their stock to the needs of local technicians who require dependable transmissions, radiators, and related components.

Parts Direct differentiates itself by focusing on warranty performance — seeking parts with the lowest return rates — and by offering direct access to the founders for technical guidance and problem solving. The company’s stated mission is to eliminate comebacks and provide a streamlined ordering experience backed by decades of combined industry experience.
